title: InsideEVs - Kia EV6 software update improves cold-weather charging
notes: Battery pre-conditioning upgrade is standard on 2023 model-year EV6; 2022 EV6 owners can get it at a dealer. Navigation-triggered (fast charger as destination, pack below 21 C, SoC below 24 %). Kia Europe quote; US availability not stated.
